dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The mid-lateral flank displays 4-5 prominent 'O' shaped structures characterized by a high-contrast dark perimeter that transitions inward over a narrow 3-5 pixel gradient to a light-grey interior. Several 'C' shaped segments are visible near the posterior region, maintaining the same dark-to-light radial gradient structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: Spatial density of high-intensity pixels is highest in the posterior-lateral quadrant, appearing as small, solid clusters without internal gradients. A localized cluster of solid low-intensity dark pixels is visible in the anterior head region, lacking organized annuli structure.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest annuli on the mid-dorsal surface form an obtuse triangle. A tighter geometric relationship is observed in the posterior-lateral section, where four smaller annuli centroids form a near-equilateral quadrilateral.
